text:
Maria: 2am confession: what's your go-to late-night snack when you're heads-down? 🥪🍪
Devin: instant ramen + egg. always. :ramen:
Alexa: popcorn with hot sauce. crunchy therapy.
Samir: cheese toastie in the toaster oven. 3 mins to life. 😌
Jules: fruit. (I know, boring) apple + peanut butter.
Maria: @Jules betrayal! :laughing: but also sometimes cereal at 3am.
Devin: can't beat a quesadilla microwaved for 45s. pro tip:
```
tortilla
cheese
fold
microwave 45s
```
Alexa: this needs a recipe channel tbh.
Samir: ops-bot reminded me of kitchen hours last week lol
ops-bot: Kitchen reminder — microwave is for community use, clean up after yourself :broom: (automated)
Jules: guilty: left crumbs last time, adding a sticky note apology.
Maria: Poll time — late-night snack ranking: 1) savory 2) sweet 3) healthy. vote with emoji.
Devin: :one: savory
Alexa: :two: sweet
Samir: :one: savory
Jules: :three: healthy (bless you)
Maria: Winner: savory. Also curious: who has an actual midnight baking habit? @Devin?
Devin: only cookies. sometimes.
Alexa: I once made bread at 2am and regretted nothing.
Samir: signed up for "midnight baking club" if that exists.
Jules: photo evidence or it didn't happen :camera_with_flash: 
Maria: ok team, submit pics tomorrow morning in #random. let's not wake the interns tonight :zzz:
